desc:
🌴 Welcome to DriveBlox! Explore Daycrest, a sunny coastal city where every mile brings you closer to your dream car, home, and lifestyle!

🚗 Drive to earn credits, unlock new cars, and work your way up through the Driver Classes!
🔧 Customize your ride with unique paint jobs, rims, neon lights, body kits, and performance upgrades!
🏡 Buy your dream home, decorate it, build your car collection, and hang out with friends!
📻 Cruise through the city with 10 radio stations, dynamic weather, and a full day and night cycle!
🏁 Challenge other drivers to drag races, show off at car meets, and capture your favorite moments in photo mode!
🌆 Whether you're racing, cruising, or just enjoying life in Daycrest, there's always something to do!

Inspired by nfsboy's original DriveBlox Unlimited (2011).

All vehicles and brands are fictional.
